data.title: Speeding fine notice, €98.50 total
data.summary: The Landkreis Beispielheide fine office issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) dated 13 October 2025 for driving 23 km/h over the limit on 21 September 2025. The total is €98.50, and 1 point is entered in the driver register.
data.explanation: You are accused of speeding 23 km/h over the limit outside built-up areas. The fine is €70.00, plus a €25.00 fee and €3.50 costs, so €98.50 in total, and 1 point is recorded. The notice was formally delivered on 17 October 2025. You may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or record it at the district office; the app shows the deadline. If you don't object, the notice becomes final and payment falls due two weeks after that. If you object, the court is not bound by the fine amount. Consider getting legal advice before deciding.

items.title: File objection to fine notice

date.text: binnen zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung

items.quote: Er muss binnen zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Landkreis Beispielheide eingelegt werden.
items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or record it at the Landkreis Beispielheide.
items.consequence: Without an objection the notice becomes final.

items.title: Pay fine of €98.50

date.text: zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist

items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, fällig; geben Sie bei der Überweisung bitte das Aktenzeichen an.
items.action: Pay the total to the Landkreis, quoting the file number (Aktenzeichen), within two weeks after the notice becomes final.
